name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.permission.QChatMemberPermissionActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user edits an individual's access to a channel. It controls whether that member can send messages, manage the channel or roles, and manage the channel's member lists.
disableEffect: Users cannot change an individual's QChat channel permissions through the built-in screen.
